_comment: Every modelling-stage knob, same convention as configs/data_config.json for the data stage. See assets/docs/05_modelling_decisions.md for why each default was picked.

regimes._comment: regime -> which dataset's manifest/split trains+validates+tests, and whether a run is 'heavy' (PlantVillage-scale, 1 seed) or 'light' (PlantDoc-scale, 3 seeds). Regime 3 reuses regime 2's dataset -- the only difference is pretrained_source.

seeds._comment: finding #2 in 04_eda_modelling_implications.md -- PlantDoc test median 9 images/class means single-run light-regime numbers aren't trustworthy; heavy regime-1 runs don't have that problem.

_numbers_note: As with the data stage, every number an actual run used (resolved epochs/lr/seed/class-weights/dataset paths, not just these defaults) is written to each experiment's config.json by scripts/train.py -- this file is only the starting point, never read directly by anything downstream of training.
